gloss: prefectural resident; citizen of a prefecture

definitions.gloss: prefectural resident; citizen of a prefecture
definitions.explanation: A person who lives in a particular prefecture of Japan, used in administrative and everyday contexts.

examples.english: To listen to the voices of prefectural residents.

examples.japanese: {県民|けんみん}{税|ぜい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{六月|ろくがつ}→六月：00662_rokugatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: The prefectural resident tax notice arrives every June.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{知事|ちじ}→知事：03467_chiji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{県民|けんみん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: The new governor is drawing the expectations of prefectural residents.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧ (prefecture) + {民|みん} (people, citizens). Refers to people who reside in one of Japan's 47 prefectures, used in government, media, and everyday speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {県民|けんみん}{税|ぜい}: prefectural resident tax
- {県民|けんみん}⟦{投票|とうひょう}→投票：03453_touhyou⟧: prefectural referendum
- {県民|けんみん}{性|せい}: regional character of a prefecture's people
- {県民|けんみん}⟦{所得|しょとく}→所得：09850_shotoku⟧: prefectural per capita income

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {都民|とみん}: Tokyo resident — same pattern but for Tokyo specifically
- ⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧: city resident — refers to residents of a city rather than a prefecture
- ⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧: national citizen — refers to the people of a country as a whole
- {府民|ふみん}: resident of Osaka or Kyoto prefecture (which use ⟦{府|ふ}→府：09870_fu⟧ instead of ⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧)
